wolfram-language-modelica.notes: Both earlier objections are fixed. Review F's legend problem: the PlotLegends list is now flat, the window capture was viewed, and the saved legend has three matching colours. Review G's missing plot output: the output cell is now saved. Residual issue, affecting the save route rather than this run: kernel-side NotebookSave goes through exportNotebook -> nb`SerializeToStream in modules/wljs-editor/src/RemoteCells.wl. That path never fires the 'OnBeforeSave' handler in FrontendObjectSync.wl, which collects frontend objects into an Objects section. A notebook made with /api/notebook/new also starts with ObjectFields {}. So the plot's graphics (FrontEndRef F3a21c737-...) live only in the running app's object store. Reopening the .wln in this session should still show the plot, but after a WLJS restart GetObject would return $Failed and only the legend would draw. This is inferred from the WLJS source; I did not open the notebook, as the brief forbids it. The GUI-saved demo notebooks (e.g. Demos/Release notes/3.1.4.wln) do carry an Objects section with a Key per FrontEndRef. The same gap applies to attempt2 and to any other run that saves graphics this way. Suggested fix, in ROUTES/tooling rather than in a rerun of this skill: after a kernel-side save, check that every FrontEndRef in the .wln has a matching Objects key, or save in a way that runs the object sync. Question for the owner: should 'notebook' require the saved .wln to redraw after an app restart?
